title: Baseline and scope
work: Record exact HEAD, dirty changes, existing private/commercial routes, models, auth and frontend assets. Read original CP requirements. Produce requirement-to-screen-to-form-to-domain map. Confirm legacy /api/commercial/v1 versus current /api/v1 mapping. Preserve current work.
exit_evidence: A complete inventory with no claim that an imported module or current three-route app supplies the missing screen workflows.

title: Shared shells and secure browser sessions
work: Implement shared templates/tokens/components, four distinct shells, exact URL routing and server session adapter. Use real empty queries and controlled issuer, current PostgreSQL RLS and private auth.
exit_evidence: Direct-route authorization, CSRF, session expiry/revocation, masked denial, safe rendering and every empty page work through actual apps.

title: Drafts and core domain vertical slice
work: Build or extend Product/PortfolioVersion/Projection/Draft/Operation/Preference repositories and migrations. Operator creates a private draft; reload/restart reads it; public catalog remains empty; a scoped private preview lists real blockers.
exit_evidence: No hardcoded list stubs, no synthetic production rows, no circular dependency on completed research. Real zero/one/many repository tests pass.

title: Public and onboarding
work: Complete PU/ID pages, eligibility flows, approved pricing/documents and discovery. Hosted identity callbacks and public projections are allowlisted and cache-safe.
exit_evidence: Public catalog/detail/compare remain truthful without releases; staff drafts never leak; onboarding does not grant payment or trade authority.

title: Customer portal
work: Complete all CU pages, selections, alerts, account performance, preferences, support and exports using actual tenant-scoped APIs and repositories.
exit_evidence: CustomerA/B isolation, unknown metrics, history pagination, interrupted requests, read-only scope and endpoint controls tested.

title: Private trading console
work: Implement all TR views/config forms on private origin against existing private services. Preserve execution semantics and report missing capabilities rather than fabricate them.
exit_evidence: Actual order families and protection transfer states render correctly; account/source changes preview; no new effects from reads or stale UI.

title: Admin and Portfolio Lab
work: Complete AD research/product/rights/review pages, persisted runs and candidate results, full denominator, revisions, effective settings and approval queues.
exit_evidence: Draft/validate/preview/review work locally before real provider histories exist. Rights and evidence blockers remain explicit at effect boundary.

title: Billing, publishers and copy setup
work: Implement all customer/operator billing, hosted connection, mandate and publication workflows with official clients and controlled protocol boundaries, then qualify real external test services only with authorization.
exit_evidence: Payment!=mandate,connected!=copying,ack!=execution;duplicate/reordered events and lost responses do not duplicate effects.

title: Managed-account and recovery UI
work: Complete PAMM/MAM investor/ops fields, dealing/NAV/fee request and status views; deployment/recovery/incident screens. Keep unapproved real program actions blocked.
exit_evidence: No investment custody through SaaS;cutoffs and corrected NAV explicit;standby inspection works without financial authority.

title: Customization and accessibility
work: Finish role/environment-scoped saved views, columns, charts, theme/density/timezone, responsiveness, keyboard/focus and accessible equivalents. Use optional packages only where justified.
exit_evidence: Required identity/origin/risk/cost/quality widgets cannot be hidden;no custom JS/CSS or financial changes in preferences.

title: Full integrated verification
work: Collect and bind every catalog case and inherited requirement. Run complete declared matrices, each form field/domain boundary, each action scope, all journeys and actual DB/API/browser integration. Preserve failures and repair consumers.
exit_evidence: No missing selected instance or fake driver;no stubs passed through “unsupported”;record code/config/data/schema/browser scope and actual evidence.

title: Inactive deployment and handoff
work: With approved access deploy actual UI/API inactive, verify origin/TLS/cache/CSP/auth/callbacks/assets and worker boundaries. Produce screen-by-screen matrix, screenshots and owner blockers.
exit_evidence: Show actual usable empty-state site, working local persisted drafts and all qualified workflows;do not claim live certification from design or synthetic tests.
